assumptions: Swath is MODELLED from an assumed ~22 deg FOV at 90 m AGL and is marked [VERIFY] in the proposal. It scales the whole model linearly.
Ground speed is SNR-limited, not line-rate-limited, in VNIR at 8 cm GSD under subtropical canopy illumination.
Operational efficiency folds in turns, battery swaps, RTH and re-flights; it is the least defensible number here and should be replaced with measured Phase 0 sortie logs.

discrepancies.detail: 36 m swath x 6 m/s = 77.8 ha/hr; the table says 46 ha/hr.

discrepancies.item: per field day vs effective rate
discrepancies.detail: 80-120 ha over 6 h implies 13-20 ha/hr, but the table separately states 25-30 ha/hr. The two rows disagree by roughly 2x.

consistency_check.recommendation: Rebuild the §5.3 table from the platform geometry rather than quoting it, and replace operational_efficiency with measured Phase 0 sortie logs. The strategic conclusion (three-tier funnel mandatory) holds under every reading, so correcting the arithmetic costs nothing and removes an easy line of attack.
